asks: Which one are you talking to?
Are they doing it too, or only me?
description: One person is standing here and rather more than one of them is arriving in your eyes. The extras are half a step off in each direction and are doing everything the original does, at their own pace.
emotes: {it} moves, and goes on moving in three places after it has stopped.
{it} steps sideways and leaves one of itself where it was.
{it} folds back down to one, briefly, and then doesn't stay there.
looks: The copies lag by different amounts. The furthest one is still finishing the last thing.
When they raise a hand, the hand keeps arriving for a while afterwards.
Looking directly at any one of them makes it the real one, which doesn't help.
name: a person with several reflections
says: Only one of us is talking.
Pick whichever you like. It makes no odds.
The others aren't saying anything, so it's fine.
